text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Eulogy. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ a woman, maybe 30s follows a person, maybe 40s, with a slouched posture in — The Eulogy still stands.
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Eater, The Influencer. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ a person, maybe 30s, with a broad frame follows a man, maybe 60s in — The Eater still stands.
🛡️ Fatima follows a woman, maybe 60s in — The Influencer still stands.
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to Old Ugly. The small teeth can wait their turn.
